channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies announces pending sale of Palm City property
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies completed consolidation of its tender-rigging operations at a Fort Lauderdale marina and announced it plans to sell its Palm City property.

item.title: Martin County School District plans to cut 16 administrative positions, save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $4 million from next year's budget.

item.title: St. Lucie man with pancreatic cancer approved for experimental treatment after 62-day wait
item.description: A St. Lucie man battling pancreatic cancer is sharing his story after finally gaining access to an experimental treatment his family hopes will give him more time.

item.title: Hobe Sound getting first Aldi grocery store July 9 at former Winn-Dixie site
item.description: Hobe Sound will get its first Aldi store when the grocery chain opens July 9 at 8867 SE Bridge Road in the space where Winn-Dixie used to be.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner says $9,000 insurance costs may force her to sell home
item.description: Kelly Hagen says skyrocketing insurance costs may soon force her out of her Vero Beach home as premiums have jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 a year.

item.title: Martin County School District to cut 16 administrative positions, save nearly $4 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to cut district staff as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year, saving nearly $3.9 million from next year's budget.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup in 4-1 loss to Belgium in Seattle
item.description: The United States lost 4-1 to Belgium on Monday night at Lumen Field in Seattle, ending American hopes for a World Cup title on home soil.

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury suffered during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Florida minimum wage workers need nearly 26 years to save for home down payment
item.description: A new study shows it now takes the median-income household in Florida 17 months longer to save for a down payment than it did a decade ago.

item.description: Taylor Morrison has begun construction on a Wilczynski-designed 18-hole golf course at its new Esplanade at Solaeris residential community in Port St. Lucie.
